name: BLOODMONEY!
source:
You’re sick. The cure? A $25,000 operation. You’re out of time – and out of luck. Then suddenly… HARVEY HARVINGTON appears! One click, one dollar. That’s his offer.

But wait – why stop at $1? More pain means more cash. Needles, blades, blunt force – make him suffer, and the money flows. How far will you go?

[From [url=https://shroomychrist-studios.itch.io/bloodmoney]Itch.io[/url]]
